basic_info.description: Welcome to a sunlit oasis in the residential part of the Mission, adjacent to some of the best amenities SF has to offer! This top floor condo boasts a large private deck with downtown views, overlooking a generous rear yard. The modern floorplan features a full master suite, operable skylight, gas fireplace, and tons of natural light. Located on a bike lane, and with ample parking, this idyllically situated home is a quick stroll to Flour + Water, Penny Roma, Trick Dog, True Laurel, Gus's Community Market, and Mission Cliffs.
